content: Baolo Banabaghala Igeniende Chonjizho
Xianxianji shiqin Igeniendeye gholuwo. BaoloBanabaghala Yutai kunlai huitande orozhi daolii goude jianjise olon Yutai kun, Xila kunla xianxin giewo.
Ulie shunjisan Yutai kunla niman kunlai shanjizhi gaijiulade doghunni sumulaghazho.

Ingiese hheghala hhende oloncha souzhi Ezhande oluzhi danzine fugiedagha giezhi kieliezho. Ezhan hhelade nenli ogizhi ghudureqi, fugie shiqin giedene hhela jianjisan Hudai nenjientu daolide ganzhen beizho.
Ingiese chenshini kunla lianbanzi gholudene ibanlie Yutai kunyi daghazho, pse ibanlie shitulai daghazho.
Niezhan niman kunla, Yutai kunla, noyenlarene hhantuladene ghua shitulai zayalazhi tashighala eghine giezhi jiejin giewo.
Shitula ene shiqinni mejiedene holuzhi Ligaonini Luside, Tebi ghua chenshide, pse zhouwini oronlade echiwo.
Hhela hhe oronlade gouxioxini chonjizho.
Luside Tebi Ghua Oronde Chonjizho
Lusidede ghua konde lilian witu nie canfei souzho. Zhayaghasanse mo yozhi ese daozho.
Baolo jianjisanyi hhe kun chenliezho. Baolo hhei goude uzhese hhende goudaku xianxin gieku zhughe wine.
Ingie fugiede kieliewo, "Chi ghua konne zhidaghazhi bosizhe!" Ingiese hhe kun jiuli bosi ire yo qiiwo.
Olon kunla Baolo giesan shiqinyi chanladene Ligaonii kielienghala fugiede kieliewo, "Nigiedala kun gholudene mai dunda irewo!"
Ingie Banabai Zhousi giezhi uruzho. Baolo zhomen jianjise Xiermi giezhi uruzho.
Chenshi ghadaneshiku Zhousi mioni buwa giedun fughe laizhi chizhe bareidene chenshi wijien melie irewo. Olon kunlare hhantu shitulade khughozhi beiine giezho.
BanabaBaologhala sonosudene jienne sidakeigha, olon kunlai dunda holu oro fugiede kieliewo,

"Dajiala, ta yale intu shiqin giene? Bijienshiye kun wo, tanre niekielien wo. Bijien enende irezhi gouxioxii chonjikushi tai gou witu dunxilase likai gieghazhi asiman, zemin, hai, pse hhei sudorodu shihenilai man zhayaghasan zhenzhenji chanqiku Hudade shunjighane giezho.
Eqighanku gonyinde Huda go minzulani durare teizhi yan giese gie giezho.
Ingieliuzhe Huda gou shiqin giezhi goyane chan zhenmin giezho. Asiman jierese ghura bouzheghazhi, nanshihoude yanyanji osighazhi, tai chudughadene zhughede bayasughazho."
Shitula ene kielienyi kieliedene olon kunlai danlazhi beigha dazhi ingiezhi goyane seigie ese beiighawo.
Niezhan Yutai kunla Anqiyase Igeniense ire olon kunlai kielie shundagha Baoloi tashighala eghi, hhe fuguwo giedene chenshi ghadane lai khighawo.
Tujila Baoloi kanzide wiqi beise hhe bosi ire chenshide orowo. Khuichudu hhe Banabaghala hhantu Tebide echiwo.
Xiliyani Anqiyade Khareizho
Hhela Tebide gouxioxii chonjidene olon kunlai tuji gholughawo. Ingiedene hhela Luside, Igenienni jingo giezhi Anqiyade khareiwo.
Hhela tujilai zhugheini khiduzheghazhi izhi xianxin gie giezhi sughazhi kieliezho. "Matan Hudai gojiade orone giese bixi olon ku shouine."
Hhela go jiohuide zhanlaolai sunghudene ese ijiezhi onxian gie, hhelai xianxin giesan Ezhandei jiuizhi ogiwo.
Ingie ghuala Bixijini jingo giezhi Panfeiliyade echiwo.
Pse Biejiade Hudai kielienyi jianjidene Yadalide bouwo.
Hhense chon souzhi Anqiyade khareiwo. Anqiyashi chonjiku wiliede oluzhi ghua shitulai Hudai nenjiende jiuizhi ogisan oron wo. Ede onchen giedene khareizhi irewo.
Anqiyade kurudene jiohuini kunlai man uru ire Huda hhelai tungo giezhi matugie giesan shiqinlai, pse Huda niman kunlai xianxin gie qiighasei kieliezho.
Hhela hhende tujilare hhantu oloncha souwo.
